# Refusals: the old pipeline's messages and the renderer's codes
#
# Phase 5's one-off review (transpiler-architecture.md §5): every key
# (input, target) both pipelines refuse, from `golden diff
# baseline-daa0ad0-fx9 <record --writer syntax at 799cf96>
# --refusal-status-only`, before `.refused` files hold codes. Each old
# message (its first line; quoted text, names and numbers replaced by
# `…`, `T`, `N`) is followed by each distinct set of codes the renderer
# gave for it, with its count and one example key. The old pipeline
# reported its first error; the renderer reports every one, so a set
# can hold more codes than the message names.
# 47845 keys, 1080 message shapes.
